title: Sulfur hexafluoride in three dimensions
hook: Turn a model of SF₆ and examine its shape.

knows: Atoms or cells can be represented with simplified models.
doesNotKnow: Six bonding regions surround sulfur in an octahedral arrangement. Rotating helps separate the front and back atoms.

misconception: A familiar diagram automatically reveals the structure or function.
objective: Six bonding regions surround sulfur in an octahedral arrangement. Rotating helps separate the front and back atoms.
